verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator for coding agents, aimed at developers and project operators. Nothing in the evidence shows it taking a mockup or design file as input and turning it into a working implementation. Its documented flow is text task descriptions run through agent loops and Git worktrees, which requires CLI and repository operation. That makes it adjacent at most, not the design-to-implementation capability for a non-engineering persona.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can go from a mockup or design to a working implementation without an engineering handoff
